authorityRule: C0-S fixes ceilings; independent C1 records candidate/control provenance and pass-fail only.

candidateAndControlIdentity.candidate: exact executable SHA-256 plus source tree, source manifest, contract manifest, lockfile hashes, feature set, OS, architecture, WebView runtime, and toolchain
candidateAndControlIdentity.control: the independently accepted ADE-0005 executable and its exact source tree, source manifest, lockfile hashes, OS, architecture, WebView runtime, and toolchain

runOrder.cleanResourceLaunch: new isolated data directory, no prior Sage process, OS file cache left natural and recorded
runOrder.invalidLaunch: discard the whole control/candidate pair, record typed reason, and rerun; never substitute or interpolate

readyIdle.entry: initialize committed ready, projection revision observed by WebView, no Turn active, ingress/egress/journal queues empty, WAL converged below checkpoint target
readyIdle.cpuFormula: sum process CPU-time delta across the owned tree divided by wall-time delta and one logical core, multiplied by 100
readyIdle.cpuAggregation: nearest-rank P95 across all valid per-interval samples; intervals spanning spawn or exit are invalid

processMembership.nativeAndRenderer: candidate Sage parent plus descendants whose parent chain reaches that exact PID and process creation time
processMembership.fixtureTree: child root recorded from the verified spawn handle plus descendants whose parent chain reaches that exact PID and creation time
processMembership.privateBytes: sum platform private/unique committed bytes for current members at each sample
processMembership.orphanCheck: zero living descendants from either owned tree 5 seconds after close

latencyAnchors.spawnToProcessReady: monotonic instant immediately before verified spawn through successful child-process handle creation
latencyAnchors.initialize: first initialize request byte write through durable ready commit
latencyAnchors.firstNormalizedOutput: last prompt request byte written through first structurally validated normalized Item accepted by Rust
latencyAnchors.nativeReceiptToPaint: Rust frame receipt monotonic timestamp through browser performance.now mark after the projection paint containing that revision
latencyAnchors.inputToPaint: trusted semantic input event timestamp through browser performance.now mark after resulting paint
latencyAnchors.cancelDispatch: trusted Cancel activation through final cancel byte write or typed local no-write disposition
latencyAnchors.cancelTerminal: trusted Cancel activation through durable terminal Turn commit
latencyAnchors.explicitClose: close request receipt through zero owned process descendants and WAL convergence

deltaFormulas.latency: candidate percentile minus matched control percentile in milliseconds; metrics present in controlRegressionMax must pass both that value and the absolute ceiling, while metrics listed in absoluteOnly use only the absolute ceiling
deltaFormulas.bytes: candidate retained or package bytes minus matched control bytes
deltaFormulas.processes: candidate owned process count minus matched control owned process count
deltaFormulas.wal: candidate WAL bytes at matching lifecycle marker minus control WAL bytes at the same marker
deltaFormulas.percentile: sort ascending and select element ceil(p*n), one-indexed; no interpolation

saturation.eachBoundary: run exact-limit then limit-plus-one in one fresh runtime epoch
